criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame a real render in one world; 1, 5 and 7 have true scale and haze. None passes the showstopper test: the exposed-down highNoon sky renders as a flat blue-grey gradient with no bleached horizon and reads overcast; a pale wash fades the foot of 1, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9. 2 is mostly flat wall, the seal a dark hole, a grey slab on the left, the ten chairs one mass at 432 px. 6 a clock on a plain slab with a painted shadow, a sky band, no ground. 4 mannequins on a plain fading to fog. 8 primitive boxes with the glass column vanishing. 9 glossy plastic bus with a fender blade and the arm flush.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One chassis world, grade and sky; the bus on 1, 5, 7 and 9; CAMERA_MOVE works. The stop arm state doesn't read; the bus material shifts from ochre on 1 to chrome yellow; hue strobes between sky and limestone.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, including 2025 from vote_year and the 2 from approached_unnamed; c39 never without c40; the Valenta link refused. The vote keeps the Tribune's attributed 10 to 3 where minutes exist.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, what and where, with an action on 9. No deadline exists. Slide 1's dek is long; the stake for an unnamed district is general.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe; 3 turns; 5 counts; 8 is the sharpest beat; 9 acts. 1 and 2 restate the same no; 4 could move.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register; attribution heavy; 6's and 7's deks are flat summary.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: highNoon and the bus are new; no. 38's light school register and parent close, the chairs of 36 and 39, and lot counts of 34 and 39 repeat.

one_sentence_fix: When the light deck cap is spent, pitch a world dark by nature (a bus barn at first light, a lit hearing room at evening) instead of dimming noon, and take the footer wash out of the chassis grade.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 70 percent flat wall; the seal a dark hole; a grey slab on the left; the ten chairs one black mass.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three quarter view from the aisle end with 1.2 m between chairs, a raking window patch on the wall, and the kit seal_plaque in bronze.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A clock on a plain slab with a painted shadow; the sector reads as a sticker; a sky band; no ground.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back to show the walkway, a bus flank and the rimrock; a real shadow on a chamfered surround; the sector lit with an emissive.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequins on an empty plain fading to fog; no shade band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera under the walkway deck with its shadow across the foreground; walkers at half size in the sun beyond; a wing and kerb across the back.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive boxes; the glass column vanishes; the foreground washed grey.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A lit frosted edge and stone caps on the glass; a window sun patch across the table; a darker near edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Cross-hatched procedural oak; the sheet flat with no readable contact; a featureless wall.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Straight-grain veneer; a 6 mm curl casting a crescent shadow; a bright window frame behind the sheet.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Glossy plastic bus with a fender blade; the arm flush; the parent in the road.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rougher paint with dust; fix the fender; swing the arm out; the parent on the kerb in the oak's shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An ochre bus with flat windows; low-poly cars; the foot washed grey.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Turn the bus so its flank takes the key; window interiors; darker near asphalt in place of the wash.
